name: 通話の出力音量を調整するバー
prompt:
Correct v001 so the complete 390×116 native component geometry matches exactly. The current card is too short and too low. Keep the no-tint white surface, slate speaker icons, and meaningful green volume value from v001, but enlarge and move the card to the exact native bounds below. Do not leave extra white space above or below the card. The finished white card should start at y8 and end at y100 on the 116px canvas.

No mint/pastel tint fills, gradient, colored glow, or ambient color. White page and card (#FFFFFF), fine neutral outline (#E8ECE9), 12px corner radius. The volume segment remains a flat, solid forest green #1F6444 because it encodes the current value. The neutral rail is #E8ECE9. The white 24px knob uses a neutral #E8ECE9 edge and very soft neutral shadow. Both speaker icons use consistent slate #526173. There is no hyperlink in this component and no blue text should be added.

Final pixel geometry on exactly 390×116: card x16 y8 width358 height92; label 音量 x30 y18 width330 height24, Meiryo Bold 14px, dark #1D1D1D; left outline speaker icon x32 y59 width24.75 height20; slider rail x72 y66 width236 height4 with 2px round ends; filled segment x72 y66 width168 height4; white knob x230 y56 width24 height24; right outline speaker icon x336 y59 width24.75 height20. The track fill ends at x308; keep the knob centered at x242 and vertically centered on the rail.

The candidate card in v001 was roughly 16px too short and 10px too low after normalization. Restore the full 92px height, position all components at the specified y values, and keep outer margins 16px left/right and 8px top/bottom. Keep text and icon sizes restrained to the native preview; do not enlarge the title or icons. No extra text, labels, numbers, mute icon, controls, decorative accents, or device frame.
reviewNotes: White no-tint surfaces, slate icons, white knob, and meaningful green slider value are preserved. v002 improves card height/position versus v001, but card remains roughly 7px too short and 8px low, and the slider knob is about 7px left of native; retain needs-correction after two passes.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
